PolyPack pieces on flat tori

P congruent pieces (disks of diameter 1, regular polygons of side 1) packed on a square torus, a hexagonal torus or a torus with any lattice. Pieces may touch; interiors of all pieces and their lattice translates are disjoint. Every score is certified with interval arithmetic and shown rounded to 6 decimals. Green: equal to a lower bound.

Generated 2026-10-24 from data/torus/records.json. Problem ids torus/<family>/<N>/<P>. Scores: side L (square, hexagonal), square root of the cell area (free lattice). Certificates: data/torus/certificates/.
